back_translation: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, O Israelites, against the whole family that I brought up from the land of Egypt:
Of all the families of the earth, I have known only you; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
Can two walk together unless they have made an appointment?
Does a lion roar in the forest when it has no prey? Does a young lion cry out from its den when it has caught nothing?
Does a bird fall into a snare on the ground when there is no bait? Does a trap spring up from the ground when it has caught nothing?
When a ram's horn is blown in a city, do the people not tremble? When calamity comes upon a city, has not the LORD done it?
Surely the Lord GOD does nothing without revealing His secret counsel to His servants the prophets.
The lion has roared—who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken—who will not prophesy?
Proclaim to the citadels of Ashdod and to the citadels of the land of Egypt: Assemble on the mountains of Samaria and see the great tumults within her and the oppression in her midst.
For they do not know how to do what is right, declares the LORD; they store up violence and robbery in their citadels.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: An enemy will surround the land; he will pull down your strength, and your citadels will be plundered.

This is what the LORD says: As a shepherd rescues from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so the Israelites who live in Samaria will be rescued—only with the corner of a bed and a piece of a couch.
Hear and testify against the house of Jacob, declares the Lord GOD, the God of Hosts:
On the day I punish Israel for its transgressions, I will also punish the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.
I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses adorned with ivory will perish, and the many great houses will come to an end, declares the LORD.
